req.title: Set cookie via path
req.statement: The system shall set a cookie of name=<name>, value=<value> and redirect to /cookies when GET /cookies/set/<name>/<value> is called.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /cookies/set/<name>/<value> must issue a Set-Cookie header with the given name/value and return a 302 redirect to /cookies. Tests cover: (1) positive EP – normal alphanumeric name/value sets cookie and redirects; (2) negative NEG – verifying the redirect target is exactly /cookies not some other path; (3) boundary BVA – single-character name and value (minimal length); (4) STC – state transition: cookie is actually readable at /cookies after following the redirect; (5) DT – special characters in value; (6) BVA – empty string value (boundary at zero-length value). Each test uses Flask test_client with follow_redirects=False to inspect the raw 302, and where needed follow_redirects=True to verify end state. Exact status codes, exact header values, and exact cookie names/values are asserted to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_set_cookie_via_path_positive_returns_302_and_set_cookie_header
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_via_path_positive_returns_302_and_set_cookie_header():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/myname/myvalue', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    set_cookie = r.headers.get('Set-Cookie', '')
    assert 'myname=myvalue' in set_cookie
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location == '/cookies'

test_set_cookie_via_path_positive_returns_302_and_set_cookie_header()

tests.name: test_set_cookie_via_path_redirect_target_is_exactly_cookies
expected: Location is NOT /cookies/set or any other path
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_via_path_redirect_target_is_exactly_cookies():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/foo/bar', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location == '/cookies'
    assert location != '/cookies/set/foo/bar'
    assert location != '/cookies/set'
    assert location != '/'

test_set_cookie_via_path_redirect_target_is_exactly_cookies()

tests.name: test_set_cookie_via_path_state_transition_cookie_readable_after_redirect

from httpbin.core import app
import json
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_via_path_state_transition_cookie_readable_after_redirect():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/session_id/abc123', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = json.loads(r.data.decode('utf-8'))
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert data['cookies']['session_id'] == 'abc123'

tests.name: test_set_cookie_via_path_multiple_cookies_independent
expected: Both alpha=1 and beta=2 appear in /cookies JSON response
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_cookie_via_path_multiple_cookies_independent():
    r1 = client.get('/cookies/set/alpha/1', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    data1 = json.loads(r1.data.decode('utf-8'))
    assert data1['cookies']['alpha'] == '1'
    r2 = client.get('/cookies/set/beta/2', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    data2 = json.loads(r2.data.decode('utf-8'))
    assert data2['cookies']['beta'] == '2'

test_set_cookie_via_path_multiple_cookies_independent()
